informal_statement: Every angle in (0,pi) is the inverse-area angle of some positive normalized area.
reason: Equivalent in the declared constructor/section context. At MorgansArcFunction.lean:279-282, the source contract is `lemma θOf_image : Ioo 0 π ⊆ θOf '' (Ioi 0)`. The unit-chord normalized area and arc length are constructed on 0 < theta < pi. The inverse is used geometrically only at positive area; its explicit totalization is not confused with an inverse outside that domain.
